decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel sits very close to the firm's core organic dairy and cheese know-how, so management can read its results and refine it, and it got its own page in 2019, which suggests it was established.

The spicy cheese line builds directly on the firm's cheese expertise, and its several variants were promoted to their own page, giving the firm a familiar base to learn from and adjust the range rather than drop it.

The mild creamy soft cheese extends the firm's existing cheese knowledge and was presented on its own page in 2019, but its sibling washed-rind soft cheese was removed, so there is moderate risk in the soft-cheese segment.
